dataStatus: Route names, colors and landmark lists are transcribed from the supplied legend image. No route has digitized geometry, ordered stops or verified directions yet.

source.name: HERE Angeles + Clark — Angeles City Jeepneys (route legend and route maps)
source.credit: © 2021 Ray Haffenden / WayGo Maps (credit printed on the supplied schematic)

routes.name: M Gate – Friendship
routes.description: Runs along Perimeter Road (Don Juico Avenue) from the Main Gate to Friendship Highway.

secondarySources.source: The Pooch of the Philippines (WordPress blog), text supplied by the project owner; original URL and date unknown
secondarySources.startPoint: Main Gate Terminal (Bayanihan Park / SM City Clark)
conflictsWithLegend: Blog calls the color 'Beige'; the legend says 'Sand'.
Blog places the Main Gate terminal at Bayanihan Park / SM City Clark; the legend only says 'Main Gate'.

routes.name: C'Point – Balibago – Hi'way
labelNotes: The legend spells one landmark 'Richtofen' here and 'Richtofer' on the Marisol – Pampang entry; verify the correct spelling.

secondarySources.source: The Pooch of the Philippines (WordPress blog), text supplied by the project owner; original URL and date unknown
secondarySources.endPoint: Jenra Grand Mall / Holy Angel University area (extends to Pampang Public Market at dawn)
conflictsWithLegend: Blog title ends in 'Holy'; the legend title ends in 'HI'WAY'.
Blog landmark list differs from the legend list (e.g. no Johnnies, Fields, SR Lim).

routes.name: C'Point – Hensonville – Holy
routes.sourceSubLabel: Check Point - Hensonville - Holy Rosary Church
routes.description: Runs from 21st Street, through Hensonville, to Holy Angel University & vice-versa.
sourceLandmarks: Holy Angel University / Holy Rosary Church
labelNotes: The legend's own text is ambiguous about the end of this route: the sub-label says 'Holy Rosary Church' while the description says 'Holy Angel University'. Verify which is correct (or whether both are served).
The description says 'vice-versa', which suggests service in both directions; the two directions have not been modelled yet.

secondarySources.source: The Pooch of the Philippines (WordPress blog), text supplied by the project owner; original URL and date unknown
conflictsWithLegend: Blog ends at Jenra Grand Mall; the legend says Holy Angel University / Holy Rosary Church (itself ambiguous).

routes.name: SM – C'Point – Holy – Hi'way
labelNotes: The route title includes 'Holy', but no 'Holy' landmark appears in the description list; verify what 'Holy' refers to.

secondarySources.source: The Pooch of the Philippines (WordPress blog), text supplied by the project owner; original URL and date unknown
secondarySources.matchToLegend: Purple jeepney — 'Check Point – Holy – Highway (Loop Route)'
secondarySources.endPoint: Loops back to Check Point / Main Gate Terminal
conflictsWithLegend: Blog says 'Purple'; the legend says 'Lavender'.
Blog title starts at Check Point and describes a loop; the legend title starts at SM and lists SM City, 1st Street, Fields, Johnnies, Marlim, SRLim, Robinsons, Marisol.
Whether this is a loop is unconfirmed.

routes.name: Clark – Main Gate – Dau
routes.description: Runs from SM City Clark to Dau along 1st Street and MacArthur to Jenra Mall for Dau/Mabalacat Bus Terminal.
labelNotes: The title mentions 'Main Gate' but the description does not; verify whether the route stops at the Main Gate.

secondarySources.source: The Pooch of the Philippines (WordPress blog), text supplied by the project owner; original URL and date unknown
secondarySources.startPoint: SM City Clark / Main Gate Terminal
conflictsWithLegend: Blog says 'Silver'; the legend says 'Steel'.
Blog ends at 'Jumbo Jenra Terminal'; the legend says 'Jenra Mall for Dau/Mabalacat Bus Terminal'.
Listing the 'Balibago strip' on a Clark–Dau route is unusual; verify.

routes.name: Marisol – Pampang
labelNotes: The legend reads 'PAMPANG' (not 'Pampanga'). 'Pampang Market' also appears on the Sapang Bato route, so the label probably refers to the Pampang area; verify before changing the wording.
'Richtofer' here vs 'Richtofen' on the Grey route; verify the spelling.

secondarySources.source: The Pooch of the Philippines (WordPress blog), text supplied by the project owner; original URL and date unknown
conflictsWithLegend: Largely consistent with the legend (blog omits Magalang and Crossing).

routes.name: Sapang Bato – Angles
labelNotes: The legend spells the destination 'ANGLES'. This is probably 'Angeles' but is preserved as written; verify.

secondarySources.source: The Pooch of the Philippines (WordPress blog), text supplied by the project owner; original URL and date unknown
conflictsWithLegend: Blog says 'Red'; the legend says 'Maroon'.
Blog reads 'Angeles', which may explain the legend's 'ANGLES' — but the legend wording is kept until confirmed.
Blog ends at Nepo Mart / HAU; the legend ends at Pampang Market.

routes.name: Pandan – Pampang
labelNotes: The legend prints 'PANDANG - PAMPANG'. The project owner (who knows the area) confirms the place is 'Pandan', so the display name uses 'Pandan'; the printed legend label is kept in sourceLabel. The route id stays 'pandang-pampang' so existing traced files keep working.

secondarySources.source: The Pooch of the Philippines (WordPress blog), text supplied by the project owner; original URL and date unknown
conflictsWithLegend: Blog spells 'Pandan'; the legend reads 'PANDANG'.
Blog says 'Dark Blue / Navy'; the legend says 'Blue'.
Blog landmarks (Salapungan, Sto. Rosario, San Nicolas) do not match the legend list (City Hall, Mining, MacArthur, Kuliat, Pamintuan Residence, Plaridel).

routes.name: Sunset – Nepo
labelNotes: The schematic map labels this line 'Sunset - Carmenville - Nepo'; the legend omits Carmenville. Verify.

secondarySourceWarning: Blog-derived text is secondary, unverified and contradicts the legend in places (colors, endpoints, route count). It is shown for contributors to check and is never used by the planner.
